sql:
WITH ln AS (
  SELECT inv_id, SUM(ext_prc - tax_amn) AS rev_before_tax
  FROM wwicryptic.sl.t_inv_lns
  GROUP BY inv_id
),
yr AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.inv_dt >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND i.inv_dt < DATE '2015-01-01' THEN ln.rev_before_tax END) AS rev_2014,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.inv_dt >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.inv_dt < DATE '2016-01-01' THEN ln.rev_before_tax END) AS rev_2015
  FROM wwicryptic.sl.t_inv i
  JOIN ln ON ln.inv_id = i.inv_id
)
SELECT ROUND(((rev_2015 - rev_2014) / NULLIF(rev_2014, 0)) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM yr

    SUM(CASE WHEN i.inv_dt >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.inv_dt < DATE '2016-01-01' THEN ln.rev_before_tax END) AS rev_2015
  FROM wwicryptic.sl.t_inv i
  JOIN ln ON ln.inv_id = i.inv_id

LIMIT 501
